draft.text: You came in because you have been having right shoulder pain for a few weeks.
The pain started after doing work in your backyard on various projects.
You describe a dull ache on the outside of your shoulder, especially when moving your arm.
The pain gets worse when lifting, raising your arm, or doing heavy lifting.
You have had prior issues with the same shoulder from playing baseball, but no surgeries.
You are willing to have an MRI to evaluate the cause of the pain.
You will continue to ice and take Advil as needed to manage the pain.
